technical.summary: Strong short-term momentum with exceptional volume spike and bullish candlestick pattern, but price remains below 200-day moving averages and trend strength is weak, limiting conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: CSGP shows no fundamental momentum: zero insider activity, no institutional signal, no government contracts, no lobbying presence, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 32 days create near-term uncertainty.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (15/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior member provides minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (369.92), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and negative macro score (-4) create severely unfavourable conditions; 32-day earnings adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Exceptional 15x volume spike combined with three white soldiers pattern and rising RSI_9 create strong short-term momentum signal with price near support at 58.2.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below both 200-day moving averages, macro environment is in crisis (VIX 369.92, inverted yield curve, rising dollar), fundamental score is critically weak (2/10), and earnings in 32 days create event risk that outweighs technical momentum.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical momentum (15x volume spike, three white soldiers, rising RSI_9) is genuine but insufficient to overcome macro crisis conditions (VIX 369.92, inverted yield curve, rising dollar) and critically weak fundamentals (score 2/10) with earnings event risk in 32 days.
decision.primary_risk: Macro environment in crisis state combined with earnings uncertainty in 32 days creates asymmetric downside risk that outweighs short-term technical setup; price below 200-day averages limits trend confirmation.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical momentum insufficient to override macro/fundamental weakness
